\textbf{Solution:} Since the direct proportion function $y= \frac{1}{3}x$ also passes through point A, \\

method.method_draft: Graphical comparison route: First read the figure: the given line slopes downward from left to right and passes through the marked point A(3,1) on the coordinate plane; the origin O and axes are shown.
